FISHING LICENCE · ARGENTINA

Argentina fishing licence

Fishing permits depend on the province and water. Castward trips include Tierra del Fuego, Santa Cruz and Corrientes; do not treat one provincial permit as nationwide permission.

Official rules ↗

Updated 2026-11-11

Who needs one

  • Visitors fishing in provincial waters that require a permit.
  • Anglers in national parks must obtain the permit for the chosen park and water.

Extra stamps and permits

  • Santa Cruz trolling permit · ARS 20000
    Required in addition to the ordinary permit; daily amount shown.

Rules visitors should know

  • Carry the provincial permit and required identity documents.
  • Iberá in Corrientes permits artificial lures only.
  • Check water-specific catch-and-release rules.
  • Río Negro states that its permit also covers Neuquén, Chubut and national parks, subject to each water's rules.

How to buy

Use Santa Cruz's SIPESQ portal, Tierra del Fuego's listed vendors and SIPED registration, or Corrientes' official natural resources licence service. Río Negro directs anglers to permisosdepesca.com.ar for the reciprocal northern Patagonia permit.

Common license questions

Do I need a fishing licence in Argentina?

Fishing permits depend on the province and water. Castward trips include Tierra del Fuego, Santa Cruz and Corrientes; do not treat one provincial permit as nationwide permission.

How much is a visitor fishing licence in Argentina?

Tierra del Fuego foreign visitor daily: ARS 78000; Tierra del Fuego foreign visitor 3-day: ARS 117000; Tierra del Fuego foreign visitor weekly: ARS 195000; Tierra del Fuego foreign visitor season: ARS 260000 (checked November 2026).

Where do I buy a fishing licence in Argentina?

Use Santa Cruz's SIPESQ portal, Tierra del Fuego's listed vendors and SIPED registration, or Corrientes' official natural resources licence service. Río Negro directs anglers to permisosdepesca.com.ar for the reciprocal northern Patagonia permit.
